Done. `npx vitest run src/renderer` → 762 passed (35 files); `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false` → 0 errors.

## What changed

**New session (agent choice)**
- `Sidebar/dialogLogic.ts`: added `validateOpenCodeModel` (+ `MAX_OPENCODE_MODEL_LENGTH = 200`, charset `A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-`, empty allowed) and `agent`/`modelRaw` on `CreateSessionForm`; `buildCreateInput` now always sends `agent`, sends trimmed `model` only for opencode (empty omitted) and omits `claudeArgs` for opencode. Tests added.
- `Sidebar/NewSessionFields.tsx`: `AgentPicker` first, "Model (optional)" + placeholder/helper + inline `role="alert"` error for opencode; the Claude args field is hidden for opencode.
- `Sidebar/NewSessionDialog.tsx`: `defaultAgent`/`defaultOpenCodeModel` optional props, agent/model state, invalid model disables submit.
- `components/AgentPicker.tsx` (new): shared keyboard-accessible segmented radio group (native radios + arrow keys).

**Settings**
- `settings/AgentsSection.tsx` (new): "Default agent for new sessions" (`updateSettings({ agents: { defaultAgent } })`) and "Default OpenCode model" (persist on blur/Enter, Quota-style inline error).
- `settings/SettingsDialog.tsx`: registered `'agents'` nav entry (Bot icon) + pane. `settings/MANUAL_TEST.md` updated.

**Badge**
- `components/AgentBadge.tsx` (new): `sessionAgent(session)` pure helper (absent = `'claude'`) + quiet `OC` pill with "OpenCode" tooltip, tokens only, `null` for Claude. Tests added.
- Shown on `SessionCard`, `HubCard`, and `Tab` (added optional `agent` to `TabModel`/`buildTabModels` in `shell/tabStatus.ts` + test — needed because `Tab` only receives `TabModel`).

## OPEN QUESTIONS / dependencies

1. **App.tsx (read-only for me).** To preselect the agent and prefill the model, pass to `NewSessionDialog`:
   - `defaultAgent?: AgentKind` — expected `settings.agents.defaultAgent`
   - `defaultOpenCodeModel?: string` — expected `settings.agents.opencodeModel`
   Both are optional with safe defaults (`'claude'` / `''`), so the app compiles unchanged; until wired, the dialog just doesn't prefill.

2. **Main-side not yet agents-aware.** `updateSettings({ agents: … })` will be rejected at runtime because `src/main/store/settings.ts` (`SETTINGS_SECTIONS`/`FIELD_CHECKS`/`settingsProblem`) and `src/main/app/settingsValidation.ts` don't include the `agents` section yet. Out of my scope (`src/main/**`); needs that worker to add `agents` (`defaultAgent: AgentKind`, `opencodeModel: string`) and the model charset/200 rule so the rule I mirrored stays authoritative.

3. Minor: I touched `shell/tabStatus.ts` (+ its test) beyond the literal owned list because the Tab badge needs the agent on `TabModel`; no other assumptions were added there.
